brief: Prioritize Camden Green (SUB-SGW-567) for pre-event attention because its advanced age reduces its margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure, as outlined in MG-023. Apply the ambient de-rating specified in MG-021, reducing the permissible load by 1.5 percent for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees over the preceding 24 hours. If the event extends beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply the further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward as required by MG-021.
